# stb_image

Sean Barrett's single-header image loader, v2.30, which the runner uses to
decode a picture the camera shows (`src/camera_source.cc`): PNG and JPEG,
the same code on every host.

`stb_image.h` is verbatim from github.com/nothings/stb at the commit in
`REVISION`, under `LICENSE` (MIT or public domain, whichever you prefer).
